data.title: list_plans discovery fallback for per-doc repos
data.summary: Update _list_plans in mcp.py to fall back to discover_plans() from serve.py when index.json has no inventory. Errors silently swallowed.

sections.body: In reckon/mcp.py, update _list_plans after the inventory read: if not inventory: try: from pathlib import Path as _Path; import json as _json; from reckon.serve import discover_plans; mounts_file = _Path.home()/'docs-server'/'mounts.json'; if mounts_file.exists(): raw = _json.loads(mounts_file.read_text()); docs_path = raw.get(project); if docs_path: discovered = discover_plans(_Path(docs_path), project, _state_root()); inventory = discovered.get('inventory', []); except Exception: pass. The except clause catches import errors, IO errors, and any serve.py errors silently.

In tests/test_mcp_tools.py: test_list_plans_from_index (existing behaviour; inventory from index.json returned correctly), test_list_plans_discovery_fallback (tmp docs dir with one minimal HTML file containing <meta name='plan-status' content='active'> and <meta name='plan-slug' content='my-plan'>; no index.json; plan appears in result after fallback).
